svg.title: Разгибание запястий с опорой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Supported wrist extension, forearms resting palms-down on a bench, hands extend unsupported beyond bench edge. Side three-quarter view, seat is separate and both forearms remain on bench. LEFT fingers and hands droop slightly below bench edge. RIGHT only wrists bend upward, knuckles rise and fingers clear bench level, forearms and elbows do not move. No dumbbells. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
